title: Example 144: short-table scan declared as the intended change, verified vacuously at the default bound (own checker)
description: Regression proof of Mica's LookupSwitch#find with a linear scan added for tables of at most eight pairs, scoped with --unchanged-unless 'matches.length <= 8' at the default --max-array-length 8: every table in the domain is among the intended inputs, so the proof covers no input. Expected: verified, vacuous (the tool prints the 'vacuously:' line after proving the probe harness, the statement with the calls replaced by the assertion's failure). Measured 0.1 s, 29 MB, one path, no solver call.

resources.notes: the last run used a stale jvmcontract; measured by the submitting session at 0.1 s
